expectations.name: main_sram_crash_dump_area
expectations.rationale: Reserved for crash-dump recovery after watchdog reset. Must survive the boot ROM untouched.

expectations.name: main_sram_persistent_config
expectations.rationale: Holds the persistent device-config blob the bootloader hands off to the app.

expectations.name: main_sram_app_heap
expectations.rationale: Application heap region: either preserved (warm reset) or cleanly zeroed (cold reset), never garbage.

expectations.name: sramx1_upper_safe_window
expectations.rationale: Empirically untouched upper half of SRAMX1, usable for small tightly-coupled scratch.

expectations.name: sramx1_rom_stack_area
expectations.rationale: Known ROM scratch/stack window. If this ever looked SAFE the ROM probably failed to run.
